mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right AEO partner for my real estate business?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO partner, look for a company with a proven track record in digital marketing for real estate, specifically demonstrating an understanding of local markets and AI search trends. Evaluate their ability to conduct thorough keyword research, create high-quality, answer-focused content, and implement technical optimizations like schema markup. A transparent reporting process and a focus on measurable ROI are also crucial indicators of a suitable partner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO partner with a proven track record in real estate digital marketing, local market expertise, content creation skills, technical optimization ability, and transparent reporting.
